why_separate: From the 2024Q1 release Gilead no longer prints Letairis on a line of its own: it is one of five products inside 'Other', so the line is a combined line and not the Letairis series. Only the U.S. row is carried, because the Letairis gold series is a U.S. series.
notes: Gilead's PRODUCT SALES SUMMARY 'Other' category, U.S. row only (the row labelled Other - U.S.), USD millions, 2024Q1 to 2026Q2. Scope proof: the category is printed as U.S., Europe and Rest of World rows with an unlabelled worldwide total; this continuation records the U.S. row, which matches the territory of the gold series (a U.S. line). The figures are NOT Letairis' own sales. The first release (2024Q1) footnote names Cayston, Jyseleca, Letairis, Ranexa and Zydelig. Dated changes: Ranexa is dropped from the footnote from the 2025Q1 release ('Includes Cayston, Jyseleca, Letairis and Zydelig'), which holds through 2026Q2. U.S. rows sum to the printed U.S. full year: 2024 255 against 255 and 2025 177 against 177.
search_log: Listed every Gilead 8-K with Item 2.02 from data.sec.gov submissions (CIK 0000882095, recent plus older files): 2024-02-06 (2023Q4, last quarter of the gold series), then 2024-04-25, 2024-08-08, 2024-11-06, 2025-02-11, 2025-04-24, 2025-08-07, 2025-10-30, 2026-02-10, 2026-05-07 and 2026-08-04 (2026Q2). No 8-K/A with Item 2.02 in that window. Downloaded Exhibit 99.1 of each of the ten releases from 2024Q1 to 2026Q2 and searched the whole text of each for the brand: it appears only in the trademark list and in the footnote quoted in the continuation evidence; no release has a row labelled with the brand.

Read the PRODUCT SALES SUMMARY of each of the ten releases: the line the footnote belongs to is printed as U.S., Europe and Rest of World rows with an unlabelled total, and the current-quarter column of each release is the source of each row (derivation direct_reported). Cross-checks: the four quarters of 2024 and of 2025 reconcile to the full-year column printed in the Q4 release within rounding, and the six-month columns of the 2026Q2 release equal 2026Q1 plus 2026Q2 for the line.

Searched the 10-Q and 10-K filings from 2024-02-23 to 2026-08-06 (FY2023 10-K, 10-Qs for 2024Q1-Q3, FY2024 10-K, 10-Qs for 2025Q1-Q3, FY2025 10-K, 10-Qs for 2026Q1 and 2026Q2) for the brand name next to a dollar figure. After the FY2023 10-K (which still prints 2023 and earlier) the brand appears only in the same footnote to the product sales table; no filing prints a figure for it alone.
No partner or royalty-holder fallback was found to print the brand's net sales on its own: see notes for the one Gilead disclosure that names a related product pair.
The U.S. row of 'Other' was chosen, not the worldwide total, so the territory matches the gold series (a U.S. line); the worldwide 'Other' total is printed in the same table and is not recorded.

continuation.evidence: Footnote (5) to 'Other' in the product sales summary of Gilead's first quarter 2024 earnings release (8-K Exhibit 99.1, 2024-04-25), https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/882095/000088209524000010/exhibit991earningspressrel.htm: 'Includes Cayston, Jyseleca, Letairis, Ranexa and Zydelig.'
